title: Add Feature Comparison
content: Create comparison table. Container: overflow-x-auto. Table: w-full border-collapse. Header row: sticky top-0 bg-white, product/plan names, price info. Feature rows: alternate bg-gray-50. Feature name: text-left font-medium. Check/X icons: green check for included, gray X or dash for not included. Category rows: bg-gray-100 font-semibold spanning all columns. Highlight column: recommended option with border and ribbon.

variants.simple: Create feature comparison table for products or plans.
variants.detailed: Create comparison table. Container: overflow-x-auto. Table: w-full border-collapse. Header row: sticky top-0 bg-white, product/plan names, price info. Feature rows: alternate bg-gray-50. Feature name: text-left font-medium. Check/X icons: green check for included, gray X or dash for not included. Category rows: bg-gray-100 font-semibold spanning all columns. Highlight column: recommended option with border and ribbon.
variants.advanced: Create comprehensive comparison component. Layout: responsive table, becomes stacked cards on mobile. Header: product images/logos, product names, prices, CTA buttons (sticky on scroll). Feature categories: collapsible sections (e.g., "Core Features", "Advanced Features", "Support"). Feature rows: feature name with optional info tooltip, values for each product (checkmark, X, partial check, text value, or number). Value types: boolean (check/X), text (specific value), number (with unit), limited (check with "(up to 100)" text). Comparison types: products, plans, versions, competitors. Add to compare: on product pages, "Compare" button adds to comparison. Max items: limit compared items (3-4), remove oldest or show error. Differences only: toggle to show only differing features. Sticky elements: headers stick on vertical scroll, first column sticks on horizontal scroll. Print/export: download as PDF, shareable comparison link. Empty state: "Add products to compare" prompt. Mobile: switch to card-per-product with feature toggles. Highlighting: hover row highlights across all columns, highlight "best" values per row. Summary: quick summary of each option at bottom. Winner badges: "Best for X" labels. Accessibility: proper table semantics, scope attributes, keyboard navigation.
